NHS Wales Shared Services Partnership-Procurement Services (hosted by Velindre University NHS Trust)

Multi provider Open Framework for various levels of specialist mental health intervention education and training (credit and non credit bearing) that is reflective of current mental health practice in Wales, for staff employed in health care.
The Framework will be opened biennially (being once every two years) to allow new entrants to the market to seek appointment onto the Framework. 
Initial Term - the first delivery of the Programme(s) shall commence from the services commencement date on 1st September 2027 and expire 31st August 2032.
Future Refresh Dates (appointment to the Framework Agreement) shall be on or around:
1st Sep 2029, [responses by 30th November 2028]
1st Sep 2031, [responses by 30th November 2030]
1st Sep 2033, [responses by 30th November 2032]*
*In the event the Framework Agreement is extended. 
There is an option to extend the Initial Term of the Framework Agreement up to 3 years until the 31st August 2035.
